en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small European town in a valley, photographed from a path leading downhill through trees and bushes. In the middle distance are tightly clustered houses with steep gable roofs, some half‑timbered. Above the town, on a wooded hill, stands a prominent castle‑like complex with a church tower or keep, dominating the skyline. The surrounding terrain is hilly and forested. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.
